title: Computational-experimental integration reveals PPARgamma/Nrf2-GPX4 dual-targeting by combined selenomethionine-magnolol as a novel therapy for sarcopenic obesity.
authors: Li, Zhe; Liu, Bingbing; Zhou, Lianghong; Chen, Na; Wang, Yi; Yang, Su; Fan, Xinyi; Wang, Yuan; Chen, Xiaodong
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和分子对接预测PPARgamma/Nrf2-GPX4靶点，结合实验验证硒代蛋氨酸-厚朴酚组合对肌少性肥胖的作用，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作（转录因子PPARgamma/Nrf2），但核心是药物靶点与疾病表型，缺乏TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法以对接和实验为主，深度不足。
abstract: Sarcopenic obesity (SO), characterized by concurrent muscle loss and excessive adiposity, lacks effective interventions. This study investigated the enhanced effects of the selenomethionine (Se-Met) and magnolol (Mag) combination against SO using an integrated computational-experimental approach. Network pharmacology and molecular docking predicted peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARgamma) and the nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 - glutathione peroxidase 4 (Nrf2 - GPX4) axis as core targets, which was corroborated by single-cell transcriptomic data analysis showing their co-expression in muscle progenitor cells. In high-fat diet ‌(HFD)-fed mice, the combined Se-Met and Mag treatment ameliorated metabolic dysregulation, reduced intramuscular lipid deposition, and improved muscle function more effectively than monotherapies. In C2C12 myotubes, the combination co-activated PPARgamma to enhance lipid clearance and potentiated the Nrf2-GPX4 antioxidant axis. Notably, it modulated ferroptosis-related signaling by downregulating acyl-CoA synthetase long-chain family member 4 (ACSL4) and upregulating ferritin heavy chain 1 (FTH1) and heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1), an effect abolished by Nrf2 inhibition. Pharmacological inhibition of either PPARgamma or Nrf2 reversed the protective benefits. Our findings reveal that Se-Met and Mag in combination target PPARgamma and Nrf2-GPX4 pathways while regulating ferroptosis-related signaling to alleviate ferroptosis-associated markers, with phenotypic characteristics consistent with ferroptosis inhibition, thereby offering a novel nutraceutical strategy for SO.
abstract_zh: 肌少性肥胖（sarcopenic obesity, SO）以肌肉流失和过度脂肪堆积并存为特征，目前缺乏有效干预措施。本研究采用整合计算-实验方法，探讨了硒代蛋氨酸（Se-Met）和厚朴酚（Mag）联合使用对SO的增强效应。网络药理学和分子对接预测过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARgamma）及核因子E2相关因子2-谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（Nrf2-GPX4）轴为核心靶点，单细胞转录组数据分析证实了这些靶点在肌肉祖细胞中的共表达。在高脂饮食（HFD）喂养的小鼠中，Se-Met和Mag联合治疗比单一疗法更有效地改善了代谢紊乱、减少了肌内脂质沉积并提升了肌肉功能。在C2C12肌管中，该组合共激活PPARgamma以增强脂质清除，并强化了Nrf2-GPX4抗氧化轴。值得注意的是，它通过下调酰基辅酶A合成酶长链家族成员4（ACSL4）并上调铁蛋白重链1（FTH1）和血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）来调节铁死亡相关信号，这一效应在Nrf2抑制后被消除。对PPARgamma或Nrf2的药理抑制均逆转了保护性益处。我们的发现表明，Se-Met和Mag联合靶向PPARgamma及Nrf2-GPX4通路，同时调节铁死亡相关信号以缓解铁死亡相关标志物，其表型特征与铁死亡抑制一致，从而为SO提供了一种新型营养策略。
